headerDisplay: Exposes [Delta Dore](https://www.deltadore.fr/) hardware to HomeKit through a **Tydom** gateway. Lights, shutters, thermostats, garage doors, contact and smoke sensors and Tyxal alarms are discovered automatically — nothing has to be listed by hand.
footerDisplay: Per-device options live under **Device settings**, keyed by the numeric device id shown in the Homebridge log at startup (`Found new tydom device ... with deviceId=1234567`). Full reference in the [wiki](https://github.com/mgcrea/homebridge-tydom/wiki/Configuration).

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: Leave as `mediation.tydom.com` to reach the gateway through Delta Dore's relay. To talk to it directly on your LAN, use its IP address or `.local` name — faster and it keeps working when the relay is down, but the gateway serves a self-signed certificate, so Node must be started with `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0`.

username.title: Username
username.description: Your gateway's MAC address, uppercase and without separators — e.g. `001A25123456`. It is printed underneath the Tydom box.

email.title: Delta Dore account e-mail
email.description:
Optional. The e-mail you sign in to the Tydom app with.

Fill it in and the password below is read as your **Delta Dore account** password: the plugin signs in at startup and fetches the gateway's own password for you. Leave it empty — the default — and the password below is the **gateway's** password, used as-is.

The account has to already own the gateway named above; this looks a password up, it cannot discover which gateways you have. Also accepted as a `HOMEBRIDGE_TYDOM_EMAIL` environment variable.

password.title: Password
password.description: Your Delta Dore account password if an e-mail is set above, otherwise the gateway's own password. Can be supplied out of band instead, as a base64-encoded `HOMEBRIDGE_TYDOM_PASSWORD` environment variable, which takes precedence over this field.

pin.title: Alarm PIN
pin.description: Required only to arm and disarm a Tyxal alarm from HomeKit. Without it the alarm still reports its state but cannot be controlled. Also accepted as a base64-encoded `HOMEBRIDGE_TYDOM_PIN` environment variable.

locale.title: Language
locale.description: Language of the labels Delta Dore supplies for alarm zones, detectors and thermostat modes. Does not affect Homebridge's own log.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How often to ask the gateway to re-push the state of everything. The gateway pushes changes as they happen, so this is only a safety net against a missed message; the default is four hours. Values below 60 seconds are clamped.

staleAfter.title: Reading lifetime (seconds)
staleAfter.description: How long a device reading is served from memory before HomeKit's next query triggers a background re-read. The gateway pushes changes as they happen, so re-reading on every query is mostly wasted traffic on a box that copes badly with chatty clients. Set to 0 to read through on every query, as releases before 0.30 did.

includedDevices.title: Only these devices
includedDevices.description: If non-empty, every device not listed here is ignored. Use the numeric `deviceId` from the startup log.

excludedDevices.title: Except these devices
excludedDevices.description: Devices to leave out. Applied after the include list.

includedCategories.title: Only these categories
includedCategories.description: HAP category numbers, if you want whole classes of device rather than individual ones: 3 fan, 4 garage door, 5 light, 7 outlet, 8 switch, 9 thermostat, 10 sensor, 11 alarm, 12 door, 13 window, 14 shutter.

excludedCategories.title: Except these categories
excludedCategories.description: Categories to leave out. Applied after the include list.

webhooks.title: Webhooks

url.title: URL
url.description: The Discord webhook URL to post to.

webhooks.description: Posts alarm events — triggered, pre-alarm, SOS — somewhere outside HomeKit. Useful because HomeKit will not notify on an alarm it did not arm.

settings.title: Device settings

debug.title: Verbose logging
debug.description: Logs every gateway request and every characteristic read and write. Noisy, and the right first step for a bug report. Your password and PIN are never logged.
